title: protocol_result
description: Output of run_protocol.py (protocol_summary.json). Includes walk-forward results, per-symbol summaries, verdict, and trade-level diagnostics from Step 03.

verdict.description: Legacy top-level verdict from the protocol's `promotion` block. null (with verdict_reason saying why) when the protocol has no promotion block -- a config-direct run's generated protocol needs none (C5.6 / D-043); nothing under config_direct_authoring reads this field.

results.description: One entry per (symbol, walk-forward window) combination.

sharpe.description: A3.4: null (not 0.0) when trade_count < 5. Distinguishes sparse windows from zero-Sharpe losing windows.

post_backtest_route_real.description: CUL-264/CUL-272: real, mechanical post-backtest cost-check route for this (symbol, window), from trading-bot/performance/signal_statistics.py::determine_route() fed real per-trade fees/edge. One of kill_no_ic, refine_inverted_ic, kill_cost_hurdle, refine_cost_hurdle, proceed_to_interpretation.

per_symbol_summary.description: Aggregated metrics per symbol across all walk-forward windows.

median_sharpe.description: A3.4: null when all windows are sparse (< 5 trades). Use per_trade_expectancy_bps instead.

zero_trade_slot_pct.description: A3.4: % of this symbol's windows with 0 trades. > 30% is a deployment risk.

hypothesis_verdict.description: Present when --validation-protocol is supplied (criteria results and the diagnostics block read by verdict-interpreter), or under --diagnostics-only (E-061 C1.3, config-direct authoring: the diagnostics block, no criteria, verdict null). Null otherwise.

below_floor_pct.description: A3.4: % of windows with trade_count < 5. When > 50%, median_sharpe rules are suspended.

per_trade_expectancy_bps.description: A3.4: present when trade_diagnostics_summary is available.

zero_trade_slot_pct.description: A3.4: global % of all window-symbol slots with 0 trades.

post_backtest_route_real.description: E-016: most common non-null results[*].core.post_backtest_route_real across all (symbol, window) slots in this run. See that field for the enum. CUL-275: when post_backtest_route_real_tied is true, this was resolved by precedence (_ROUTE_TIE_PRECEDENCE in run_protocol.py), not by a clear majority -- see that field.

post_backtest_route_real_tied.description: CUL-275: true when two or more distinct route values in results[*].core.post_backtest_route_real were tied for most-common across (symbol, window) slots -- statistics.mode()'s silent, iteration-order-dependent tie behavior is what this replaces. When true, post_backtest_route_real was resolved by a documented precedence order (kill_no_ic > refine_inverted_ic > kill_cost_hurdle > refine_cost_hurdle > proceed_to_interpretation), not by a clear majority; verdict_interpreter should not treat it as unambiguous mechanical ground truth. false when there was a clear majority, or when no window produced a post_backtest_route_real value.

cost_dominated_real.description: E-016: true when post_backtest_route_real is kill_cost_hurdle or refine_cost_hurdle -- the REAL, mechanical trigger for verdict_interpreter's fee-reduction autopsy (see fee_reduction_metrics below and workflow_artifacts/skills/verdict-interpreter/SKILL.md). null when no window produced a post_backtest_route_real value.

fee_reduction_metrics.description: E-016: present when trade_diagnostics_summary is available. Full field definitions in trade_diagnostics.schema.json.

trade_diagnostics_summary.description: Step 03 summary block. null when no trades occurred in any window. Full per-trade records in trade_diagnostics.json.
